name: Sirpi Trust Box for WooCommerce
author: Abdul Majeed Ali

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP via WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Sirpi Trust Box for WooCommerce.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Sirpi Trust Box to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Where does the trust box appear?

The trust box appears on WooCommerce single product pages. The position can be configured in the plugin settings.

Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.
sections.description: A configurable trust box for WooCommerce single product pages with delivery estimates, shipping notices, discounts, and payment icons. Features include: – Delivery date range (today + X days to today + Y days) – Free delivery text with optional minimum order value – Discount line – Secure payment line with selectable payment icons – Optional uploaded PNG or SVG payment icons – Choose display position (above short description, below short description, below add to cart button, or after add to cart form)
